items.reply: I change to TP/nit. The assertion can pass on feature-disabled failure, but Picocli parses arguments before the gate in run(), so that gate cannot mask a missing-required-option parsing failure. This test targets omission of --file; testCompatible separately verifies enabled metadata execution with output and exit-code assertions. Adding a success assertion here is test strengthening rather than a newly broken behavioral check. Severity remains medium when rating the test gap as the comment states it.
